wiki.summary: The track "Garden of Hopes and Dreams" is an adapted and abridged version of insaneintherainmusic's 2018 jazz fusion fan arrangement of the track "Field of Hopes and Dreams" from Deltarune Chapter 1. Read more on Last.fm.
